palette.notes: Metrics: characterIdle 18 colours, acting GIFs 16-19, effects 10-31, 1-bit 4. Ramps hue-shift both ways (+46 and -28 degrees in one GIF). Cool dark backgrounds, warm orange heroes.

lighting: One clear key light per sprite; the IlluminationTechniques and Shading cards build volume step by step (Shading holds each step, median 600 ms).
silhouette: Silhouette card starts from a solid flat shape, then adds detail: a pose must read as a filled shape first (first frame held 1800 ms).

motion.timing: Metrics: holds 80-100 ms (10-12.5 drawings/s) almost everywhere; walk 12 frames/1.2 s; attack anticipation held 300 ms; impact uses a 20 ms frame; Cuteness mixes 30-120 ms.

texture: Clean flat clusters, almost no dithering (dither share about 1-2%); tiny native size (256 px at 2x).
camera: Fixed small stage per card; Parallax card shows layers scrolling at different speeds; City card holds the scene for 3000 ms between beats.

acting.enters: In the City card a car drives in from the edge into a held, quiet street.
acting.acts: Attack: long held windup, fast strike, recovery; Death: hit, fall, settle; Cuteness: big head, round shapes; Defend: brace before the projectile lands.
acting.exits: Death and Breaking end on a held settled pose, then the loop restarts.
acting.depth: Parallax: a flying creature crosses in front of slower far layers; small sprites in wide sets.

techniques: held anticipation (300 ms) before a fast strike
single very short impact frame (20 ms) plus particles
silhouette first: pose must read as a flat fill
steady 80-100 ms holds, pauses for emphasis only
long scene hold (3000 ms) between beats
feel: steady 80-100 ms holds + one long anticipation + a flash impact frame = punchy, readable small acting
for_fred: Give Fred's gag a 300 ms held windup, a fast action and a settled hold, then let the scene sit empty for a beat before he swims back in for the second try. Check every Fred pose as a flat silhouette first.
